checked.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the brands were last checked.

tags.description: Tags available for brands, in the order their filter checkboxes appear. Every id used in a brand's `tags` must be defined here.

name.description: Brand or retailer name. One entry per brand.

website.description: Full URL of the site that was checked, or null if there is none.

status.description: live = Black Friday sale is live; other_sale = a non-Black-Friday sale is on; not_yet = no sale; unknown = couldn't check; closed = no longer operating.

detected.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the Black Friday sale was first seen live. Set it the first day status becomes `live` and never change it after; null while no Black Friday sale has been seen.

tags.description: One or more tag ids from the top-level `tags` list.

type.description: Free-text description of what the brand makes or sells; may be empty.

notes.description: What was seen on the site.

country.description: Home country, or for retailers where they ship from.
